prerequisites: To defend the Final Degree Project, it is a requirement to have passed all other credits the student must complete to obtain the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Original individual work to be carried out and presented and defended before a university committee, consisting of a project in the field of specific technologies of Industrial Engineering of a professional nature in which the competencies acquired in the studies are synthesized and integrated.
Capacity for organization and planning in the field of business and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
That students can transmit information, ideas, problems and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.
That students have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data (usually within their area of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific or ethical issues.
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the Industrial Technical Engineer profession.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.

That students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds on general secondary education, and is usually found at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes some aspects that involve knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

That students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional way and possess the competencies that are usually demonstrated by the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their area of study.
That students have developed those learning skills necessary to undertake further studies with a high degree of autonomy.

Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering whose object is the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacture, installation, assembly or exploitation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing and automation processes.
Competence in the sustainable use of resources and in the prevention of negative impacts on the natural and social environment.
Competence in the application of ethical principles related to sustainability values in personal and professional behavior.
Competence in the critical contextualization of knowledge, establishing interrelations with social, economic and environmental problems, local and/or global.
Competence in participation in community processes that promote sustainability.

syllabus_topics: Individually carry out, present and defend before a university committee, a project in the field of specific technologies of Industrial Engineering of a professional nature in which the competencies acquired in the studies are synthesized and integrated.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of the final degree project in a public session before a university committee in accordance with the provisions of the ESI FDP/MDP Regulations.

assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of an oral presentation of the final degree project in a public session before a university committee, following the regulations of the Higher School of Engineering for final degree/master projects. This presentation accounts for 100% of the final grade.
